questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion with the main clause beginning the sentence for emphasis, given that the subordinate clause is a question form?
options: It was not until she finished her work that she realised how important the project was.
Only when the meeting ended did she notice the lack of attendance from the team.
Had she known the rules beforehand, she would have prepared more thoroughly.
Because she was tired, she didn’t realise she had missed the bus.
questions.answer: Only when the meeting ended did she notice the lack of attendance from the team.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence correctly restates the information about the most expensive item in the shopping list?
options: The item that was the most expensive on the list was the designer handbag.
It was the designer handbag that was the most expensive item on the list.
What the list contained was the most expensive item, which was the designer handbag.
The list’s most expensive item was the designer handbag, which was purchased last.
questions.answer: The item that was the most expensive on the list was the designer handbag.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation where a request is made?
options: If she were to win the competition, she would donate all her prize money to charity.
She wishes that she had studied harder so that she could pass the exam.
He insists that the meeting should be postponed until tomorrow.
They suggested that we should have left earlier to avoid the traffic.
questions.answer: He insists that the meeting should be postponed until tomorrow.

questions.question: Which sentence uses ellipsis effectively to avoid repetition while maintaining clarity and formality?
options: She asked him to join her at the café, and he said he’d be there in five minutes.
Although he had planned to attend, he decided to cancel at the last moment.
He mentioned that he would have preferred to stay home but had to go out anyway.
They discussed the matter at length, and in the end, they agreed on a compromise.
questions.answer: He mentioned that he would have preferred to stay home but had to go out anyway.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a complex structure with a nuanced conditional clause to express a situation where an action is dependent on an uncertain outcome?
options: If she had known the truth sooner, she would have handled the situation differently.
In case it rains, we should bring an umbrella to the picnic.
Unless you confirm your attendance by Friday, we will proceed without you.
Had the team not practiced extensively, they would not have performed well in the tournament.
questions.answer: Unless you confirm your attendance by Friday, we will proceed without you.
